en.description:
Squickly is fun and colorful endless runner. Quickly jump over spikes and last as long as you can for the high score!

Collect tokens as you jump over spikes and avoid obstacles. There are a bunch of cool color schemes to unlock and many more to come that celebrate some awesome things going on!

Game Modes:
- Arcade
Enjoy the same Squickly you've been used to, now in it's own dedicated game mode.

- Blitz!
Enjoy a more challenging experience as you dodge and survive more obstacles. Reach Gates to secure your rewards and increase your multiplier. Earn more rewards, gain higher scores, but be careful not to risk it all. Try out Blitz!
en.releaseNotes:
- Enhanced UI layout handling
- Improved touch input detection
- Minor fixes and improvements
